_README: Human-labeled golden set for the open-model bake-off (extract-structure). Each record's `expected` is a hand-VERIFIED JobStructureForDB for the matching fixture job id in gemini-sample-jobs.json. Scoring a model against this set measures CORRECTNESS, not just similarity to Gemini. Populate ~25-30 stratified jobs, then run: npx tsx --env-file=.env.local scripts/model-bakeoff.ts --scenario=extract-structure --models=gemini-flash-latest,glm-5.2,deepseek-v4-flash --reference=golden. Until populated, omit --reference=golden and the harness scores against the Gemini baseline output instead.

_schema.jobId: string (must match an id in gemini-sample-jobs.json)
